{{Quote|Loyalty. Duty. Honor. The Imperial Navy secures our Empire's dominance across the far corners of the galaxy. Report to recruitment staff for more information.|An Imperial announcer|<ref name="TOR:VS">{{TORcite|type=other|Vaiken Spacedock}}</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Navy''', also called the '''Imperial Armada''' or the '''Imperial Fleet''', was the naval branch of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial military]]. It fought against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and was maintained throughout the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed. It was constructed over several centuries at the order of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Odile Vaiken]], who knew that he would not live to see a fraction of it complete.

==History==
When the original [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] collapsed and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] went into exile in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], the navy shrunk to a small group of ships used to travel by the remnant. After finding refuge on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the Sith began a massive build up of military forces under [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Odile Vaiken]]. He started construction on a massive armada that took nearly three centuries to complete, knowing he would not be alive when it was done. All non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] people living on Dromund Kaas were conscripted either into the Navy or the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]]. Vaiken died during the first operation undertaken by the Navy, [[Odile Vaiken's final campaign]] against an alien race.

During the [[Great Galactic War]], the Navy proved to be a vital component of the military. They transported Army troops to various worlds, taking part in various engagements with the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. Those included [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region]], and the [[First Battle of Bothawui|first]] and [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|second Battles of Bothawui]]. In the final act of the war, a massive fleet was used to [[Sacking of Coruscant|sack]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the capital of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It led to the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], causing the Navy to stop activities.

==Organization==
[[File:Imperial_Navy_Sith_Empire.png|thumb|right|240px|Imperial Fleet arrives to help the Alliance during the [[Invasion of Voss]]]]
The Imperial Navy was the naval branch of the Imperial Military, and was overseen by the Ministry of War alongside the Army.

==Equipment==
[[File:Hound_Group.jpg|thumb|left|250px|By the time of the Third Galactic War the Empire possessed multiple drednaughts enhanced with Isotope-5.]]
The primary vessel of the Navy was the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]], a colossal [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] produced by [[Taerab Starship Manufacturing]] and measuring greater than 800 meters in length. The ''Harrower''-class was operated by 2,400 personnel with the capacity to hold an additional 7,300 marines. Commanders typically chose the ''Harrower''-class as their command ship, finding its prevalence and size as a true example of Imperial dominance in battle.

Aiding the ''Harrower''-class in was the [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus'']]-class destroyer. A more rigorously armed warship than its Republic counterparts, it was built to act as an escort to the larger ''Harrower''-class, as well as an independent patrol vessel.

The Sith Empire used several unidentified classes of shuttle and dropship. The Navy also utilized a number of starfighters, with the [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Mark VI ''Supremacy''-class starfighter]] as the standard starfighter of the Navy and the [[B28 Extinction-class bomber|B28 ''Extinction''-class bomber]] as the standard bomber.

The [[Delta-class carrier]], the [[Keizar-Volvec bulk cruiser]], the [[Gage-class transport|''Gage''-class transport]], the [[Imperial shuttle]], the [[Imperial assault shuttle]], the [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor]], the [[Dragonfly-class Imperial drop ship]], the [[Imperial military transport]], and the [[VT-22 light troop transport]] were support ships.

Starfighter bombers and bomber groups included the [[B-4D Legion]], the [[B-5 Decimus]], the [[B28 Extinction-class bomber]], the [[D-1Z prototype bomber]], the [[G-X1 Onslaught]], and the [[M-7 Razorwire]]. The [[IL-5 Ocula]], the [[S-12 Blackbolt]], the [[S-13 Sting]], and the [[S-SC4 Bloodmark]] were scout ships. Additional starfighters included the [[F-T2 Quell]], the [[F-T6 Rycer]], the [[FT-3C Imperium]], the [[Mk. VII advanced interceptor]], and the [[TZ-24 Enforcer]]

Gunships included the [[GSS-3 Mangler]], the [[GSS-5C Dustmaker]], the [[K-52 Strongarm]], and the [[VX-9 Mailoc]].
